links.title: Servers
links.tooltip: Host metrics of the selected nodes

panels.title: Running pods
panels.description: Pods in phase Running.

targets.expr: count(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name", "k8s.pod.uid") (label_match(label_copy(label_replace({__name__="k8s.pod.phase", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}, "workload", "$1", "k8s.pod.name", "(.+?)(-[0-9]+)?"), "k8s.job.name", "workload", "k8s.cronjob.name", "workload", "k8s.daemonset.name", "workload", "k8s.statefulset.name", "workload", "k8s.deployment.name", "workload"), "workload", "$workload")) == 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pending pods
panels.description: Pods not yet scheduled or still pulling images. **Bad:** > 0 for minutes: no node fits the requests (see *Node capacity*), a PVC cannot bind, or an image cannot be pulled. `kubectl describe pod` shows the event.

panels.title: PVCs full within 7 days
panels.description: PVCs whose free space runs out within 7 days on the 6h trend, or ≥ 97% full. See *Storage*.

targets.expr: count(((max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") ({__name__="k8s.volume.available", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.volume.type="persistentVolumeClaim"}) / -deriv(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") ({__name__="k8s.volume.available", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.volume.type="persistentVolumeClaim"})[6h:5m]) and deriv(max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") ({__name__="k8s.volume.available", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.volume.type="persistentVolumeClaim"})[6h:5m]) < 0) or ((1 - max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") ({__name__="k8s.volume.available", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.volume.type="persistentVolumeClaim"}) / max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name") ({__name__="k8s.volume.capacity", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.volume.type="persistentVolumeClaim"})) > 0.97) * 0) < 604800) or vector(0)

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Grafana alerts currently firing or pending (all folders).

panels.title: Node capacity
panels.description:
Per node: what the scheduler has promised (**requests**) and what is really used, against allocatable.

- **Requested ≈ 100%**: new pods stay Pending even if the node is idle. Lower over-sized requests (*Right-sizing*) or add a node.
- **Used ≫ requested**: pods rely on unrequested capacity and starve each other under load; raise their requests.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_cpu", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") (max by ("k8s.node.name", "k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name", "k8s.container.name") ({__name__="k8s.container.cpu_request", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}) and on ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") (max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") ({__name__="k8s.pod.phase", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}) == 2)) / max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_cpu", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") (rate({__name__="container.cpu.time", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}[5m])) / max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_cpu", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")
label_move(max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_memory", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") (max by ("k8s.node.name", "k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name", "k8s.container.name") ({__name__="k8s.container.memory_request", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}) and on ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") (max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") ({__name__="k8s.pod.phase", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}) == 2)) / max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_memory", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="container.memory.working_set", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}) / max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.allocatable_memory", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

panels.title: CPU against limit
panels.description:
Usage / limit for containers that have a CPU limit (most here have none). There is no CFS throttling counter in this pipeline, so **pinned at 1.0 = being throttled**.

**Fix:** raise or drop the limit (keep the request), or make the app use fewer cores.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name", "k8s.container.name") (label_match(label_copy(label_replace(rate({__name__="container.cpu.time", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]), "workload", "$1", "k8s.pod.name", "(.+?)(-[0-9]+)?"), "k8s.job.name", "workload", "k8s.cronjob.name", "workload", "k8s.daemonset.name", "workload", "k8s.statefulset.name", "workload", "k8s.deployment.name", "workload"), "workload", "$workload")) / max by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name", "k8s.container.name") (label_match(label_copy(label_replace({__name__="k8s.container.cpu_limit", k8s.namespace.name=~"$namespace", k8s.node.name=~"$server", k8s.pod.name=~"$pod"}, "workload", "$1", "k8s.pod.name", "(.+?)(-[0-9]+)?"), "k8s.job.name", "workload", "k8s.cronjob.name", "workload", "k8s.daemonset.name", "workload", "k8s.statefulset.name", "workload", "k8s.deployment.name", "workload"), "workload", "$workload")), "k8s.namespace.name", "namespace", "k8s.pod.name", "pod", "k8s.container.name", "container")

panels.title: CPU right-sizing
panels.description:
Per workload container over the time range, busiest replica. **p95 / request**: blue < 0.25 = over-provisioned (the request blocks capacity others could schedule on); orange > 1 = uses more than it asked for (starves under contention); red > 2.

**Fix:** set the request near p95 and leave the CPU limit off unless the app misbehaves.
